content: The solubility of ciprofloxacin can be reduced in the presence of alkaline urine. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of ciprofloxacin through an unknown mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. When ciprofloxacin extended-release tablets are co-administered with omeprazole, absorption is slightly reduced by approximately 20%. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of citalopram by inhibiting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19. Caution and monitoring are recommended. The maximum recommended dose of citalopram for patients taking CYP2C19 inhibitors is 20 mg/day due to the risk of QT prolongation. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of crizotinib by increasing gastric pH, which applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Drugs that elevate gastric pH may reduce the solubility and bioavailability of crizotinib. However, no formal studies have been conducted. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of clobazam by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of omeprazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Similarly, conivaptan also increases omeprazole levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Caution and monitoring are advised in both cases. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of crizotinib by increasing gastric pH, which applies only to oral forms. Drugs that elevate gastric pH may reduce crizotinib solubility and bioavailability. No formal studies have been conducted. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Long-term use of proton pump inhibitors (PPIs), such as omeprazole, may cause hypomagnesemia and increase the risk of toxicity when co-administered with drugs like cyclosporine. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of dabrafenib by increasing gastric pH, which applies only to oral forms. Drugs that alter upper gastrointestinal tract pH, such as PPIs, H2-blockers, or antacids, may reduce dabrafenib solubility and bioavailability. Conversely, dabrafenib decreases omeprazole levels by affecting CYP2C19 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Deferoxamine decreases the levels of sodium bicarbonate by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate and deflazacort both decrease serum potassium levels. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate increases the levels or effects of dextroamphetamine by enhancing passive renal tubular reabsorption in basic urine. Omeprazole may also alter the pharmacokinetics of dextroamphetamine by reducing gastric acidity, which decreases the time to peak concentration (Tmax) without affecting the area under the curve (AUC). Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of diazepam (both buccal and intranasal forms) by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Strong or moderate CYP2C19 inhibitors may slow diazepam elimination, increasing the risk of adverse reactions. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the effects of enalapril through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of dichlorphenamide by decreasing serum potassium. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Omeprazole increases the toxicity of digoxin due to prolonged PPI use, which may cause hypomagnesemia and increase the risk of digoxin toxicity. Caution and monitoring are advised. Efavirenz has a dual effect on omeprazole, increasing its levels via CYP2C19 inhibition and decreasing its levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Elagolix increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 and decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP3A4. Therapy modification and close monitoring are advised. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer, and dose adjustments for CYP3A substrates may be necessary. Omeprazole increases the levels of eluxadoline by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Due to incomplete information on eluxadoline metabolism, caution is advised when co-administering with strong CYP2C19 inhibitors. Encorafenib affects omeprazole metabolism by both inhibiting and inducing CYP3A4. Co-administration with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates may increase toxicity or reduce efficacy. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate increases the levels or effects of ephedrine by enhancing passive renal tubular reabsorption in basic urine. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate increases the levels of various erythromycin formulations (base, ethylsuccinate, lactobionate, and stearate) through an unknown mechanism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of escitalopram by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Eslcarbazepine acetate increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of esmolol by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of etidronate by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fedratinib increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose adjustments for CYP3A4 substrates may be necessary. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of ferric gluconate, ferric maltol, ferrous fumarate, ferrous gluconate, and ferrous sulfate by increasing gastric pH. These interactions apply only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fexinidazole increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate increases the levels or effects of flecainide by enhancing passive renal tubular reabsorption in basic urine. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of finerenone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Serum potassium should be monitored during initiation and dosage adjustments. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of flibanserin by inhibiting both CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Fluconazole increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of fosamprenavir by increasing gastric pH. Sodium bicarbonate has a similar effect. These interactions apply only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the effects of fosinopril through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fosphenytoin decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of gabapentin and gabapentin enacarbil by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. These interactions apply only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole decreases the levels of gefitinib by increasing gastric pH. Co-administration with PPIs should be avoided if possible. If required, doses should be separated by 12 hours. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate increases the levels or effects of glipizide and glyburide by increasing gastric pH. These interactions apply only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of ibandronate by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Iloperidone increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the effects of imidapril through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of imipramine by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of iron dextran complex, iron sucrose, and polysaccharide iron by increasing gastric pH. These interactions apply only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of isoniazid by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Istradefylline increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose reductions of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates may be necessary. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of itraconazole and ketoconazole by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. These interactions apply only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of labetalol by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the effects of lactulose through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole decreases the levels of ledipasvir/sofosbuvir by increasing gastric pH. However, doses of omeprazole <20 mg can be administered simultaneously with ledipasvir/sofosbuvir under fasted conditions. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of lemborexant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Lower nightly doses of lemborexant are recommended when co-administered with weak CYP3A4 inhibitors. Therapy modification and close monitoring are advised. Letermovir increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose adjustments may be necessary. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of levoketoconazole by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the effects of lisinopril through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole increases the levels of lomitapide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The lomitapide dose should not exceed 30 mg/day. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor is a strong CYP3A4 inducer and may also induce or inhibit CYP2C19. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate increases the levels or effects of memantine by enhancing passive renal tubular reabsorption in basic urine. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Omeprazole increases methotrexate levels by decreasing renal clearance. Temporary withdrawal of PPIs may be considered in some patients. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of methscopolamine by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole decreases the effects of methylphenidate by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of metoprolol by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate increases the levels or effects of mexiletine by enhancing passive renal tubular reabsorption in basic urine. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Omeprazole increases the levels or effects of midazolam intranasal by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Modafinil increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the effects of moexipril through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of mycophenolate by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to oral forms, particularly mycophenolate mofetil. Enteric-coated mycophenolate sodium is less sensitive to this interaction. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of nadolol by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir and dasabuvir decrease omeprazole levels through an unspecified mechanism. Monitoring for reduced omeprazole efficacy is recommended, and dose increases may be considered (not exceeding 40 mg/day). Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of nebivolol by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of nitrofurantoin by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels or effects of omadacycline by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Multivalent cation-containing products may impair tetracycline absorption, reducing efficacy. Dosing should be separated. Oxcarbazepine increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of pamidronate by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of penbutolol by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of penicillamine by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Pentobarbital decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the effects of perindopril through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Phenobarbital decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Phenytoin decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of pindolol by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of polysaccharide iron by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are advised. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of posaconazole by increasing gastric pH. Conversely, posaconazole increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Sodium bicarbonate also decreases posaconazole levels by increasing gastric pH. These interactions apply only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Primidone decreases omeprazole levels by inducing both CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of propranolol by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate increases the levels or effects of pseudoephedrine by enhancing passive renal tubular reabsorption in basic urine. Caution is advised with frequent or high-dose antacids. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the effects of quinapril through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate increases the levels or effects of quinidine by enhancing passive renal tubular reabsorption in basic urine. Elevated quinidine plasma levels may lead to cardiac conduction disturbances and arrhythmias. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the effects of ramipril through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP2C19 metabolism. Sodium bicarbonate decreases rifampin levels by reducing absorption. Rifampin should be administered at least 1 hour before antacids. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of riociguat by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Omeprazole also decreases riociguat levels by increasing gastric pH. These interactions apply only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of risedronate by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Ritonavir increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Omeprazole decreases the levels or effects of rose hips by increasing gastric pH. Sodium bicarbonate has a similar effect. These interactions apply only to oral forms. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of rosuvastatin by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. St. John’s Wort decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Sparsentan decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP2C19 metabolism. Sparsentan, a CYP2C19 inducer, reduces the efficacy of CYP2C19 substrates. Caution and monitoring are advised. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels or effects of sarecycline by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Multivalent cation-containing products may impair tetracycline absorption, reducing efficacy. Dosing should be separated. Sodium bicarbonate and sodium sulfate/potassium chloride/magnesium sulfate/polyethylene glycol both decrease serum potassium levels. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of sotalol by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Doses should be separated by 2 hours. Caution and monitoring are advised. Stiripentol increases omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Stiripentol is both a CYP3A4 inhibitor and inducer. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Omeprazole increases tacrolimus levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Concomitant administration may increase tacrolimus blood concentrations, particularly in intermediate or poor CYP2C19 metabolizers. Caution and monitoring are advised.
